citations.title: God Is Infinite
citations.text: The perfections of creatures — their truth, their goodness, their beauty — reflect the infinite perfection of God. He is infinite in all his perfections, and we can name him only by taking creatures as our starting point, according to our limited human ways of knowing.

citations.title: God Is Eternal and Unchanging
citations.text: By revealing his name, God at the same time reveals his faithfulness. His being and his truth are without beginning or end. Nothing that he has made can take back what he has once conferred, or change what he has once said.

citations.title: God Sustains All Things
citations.text: With creation, God does not abandon his creatures to themselves. He not only gives them being and existence, but also, and at every moment, upholds and sustains them, enabling them to act and bringing them to their final end.

citations.title: God's Knowledge Is Perfect
citations.text: God is the sovereign master of his plan. Nothing can escape his knowledge or be taken from his power; he sees and knows all things, even the most hidden, and nothing is impossible with him.

citations.title: God Is Almighty
citations.text: Holy Scripture repeatedly confesses the universal power of God. He whose power is at work in all things is he to whom all things are possible. God's almighty power is in no way arbitrary, for it is always at the service of his wisdom, goodness, and love.

citations.title: Creation Reflects God's Goodness
citations.text: Because God creates through wisdom and love, creation is good and reflects the infinite goodness of its Creator. Each creature possesses its own particular goodness, and taken together, all things bear witness to a supremely good God.
He who does not love does not know God; for God is love.
But to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
The Lord passed before him, and proclaimed, "The Lord, the Lord, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness."
Know therefore that the Lord your God is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and steadfast love with those who love him and keep his commandments, to a thousand generations.

citations.title: God's Holiness
citations.text: God alone is holy in an absolute sense. He is the source of all sanctity, and he causes those who have been called to holiness to be made holy in his likeness.

citations.title: One God in Three Persons
citations.text: The Trinity is One. We do not confess three Gods, but one God in three Persons. The divine Persons are really distinct from one another, yet they do not divide the divine unity; each Person is fully God, and God is fully in each Person.

citations.title: Dei Verbum
citations.quote: Through divine revelation, God chose to show forth and communicate himself and the eternal decisions of his will.
